_comment: Q8 SSOT. Feature-recipe path/naming manifest. Loaded by BOTH arxa-designer and
arxa-scaffolder so their outputs converge on the same tree.
PROVENANCE: derived by abstraction from kit/showcase_app/lib (207 .dart files), which
Q1 locks as the structure contract, not an example. Showcase itself MUST pass the
golden-expansion probe against this manifest (Q8 gate).
PLACEMENT: showcase-adjacent by Q8, so both skills read one copy. The sibling
feature-recipe.schema.json must stay in this directory — the $schema pointer above is
relative. Move the pair together or not at all.
NOT here: kind-resolution.registry.json (Q7) lives in skills/arxa-scaffolder/.

app.description: App slug. Prefixes nearly every app-owned file and directory (Q1 <app>_<feature>_ naming).

feature.description: Feature slug. One feature owns one shell plus its widget/service/model/schema/enum buckets.

surface.description: One screen inside a shell. Registry id is the stable key (§18).
surface.note: A surface slug is NOT required to equal its feature slug: showcase_notes_shell contains surfaces notes, note_editor, notes_folder, notes_auth, notes_create_account.

factor.description: Form factor. DERIVED from --targets via pipeline/state/targets.derivation.json + config viewports (P06). Never a per-surface literal, never read from ambient pipeline state.
factor.rule: A factor absent from the derived set produces NO file. Emitting an empty .mobile/.tablet to satisfy a counter is the stale-green defect §16 exists to kill.

widgetGroup.description: Sub-bucket under ui/widgets/common/ for cross-feature shared widgets.

ownership._comment: Q9 generation-gap boundary, declared up front. scaffolder = deterministically regenerated, byte-identical on unchanged inputs, hand edits are drift (--check fails). user = written once as a stub then owned by the builder/human; regeneration NEVER clobbers, divergence gate only verifies against the last-generated baseline.

values.scaffolder: Scaffolder-owned. Regenerated every run. Additive-only diff. Idempotence asserted by the golden probe.
values.user: User-owned after first emit. Scaffolder writes the stub once; subsequent runs leave it untouched.
values.shared-join-point: Scaffolder-owned aggregation point (barrels, router, locator, manifest). Deterministically regenerated; unchanged inputs => byte-identical entries.

frontmatterKinds._comment: Q5: the semantic library doc comment in showcase files is NORMATIVE. Canon: skills/arxa-builder/BUILDER_playbook.mdx -> File structure. Every emitted file carries the doc comment ABOVE a bare `library;` directive. Order is locked. The scaffolder emits the layer-intro + role + History lines verbatim-derived and leaves the requirements/relationships bodies as a marked placeholder the builder fills.

sections.note: Fixed prose per artifact kind. Identical across every file of that kind.
One paragraph: what THIS file is, derived from the registry surface/widget label.
Numbered `/// N. [Label] — requirement-slug` pairs from the registry; body line per item written by the builder.
ASCII box diagram + streams (STRM) / actions (ACT) legend, joined by the `abxAction` rail.
`/// History: git log --follow -- <repo-relative path>` — mechanically derivable, so mechanically gated.

inspectAttrs._comment: Q12: identity is STAMPED AT EMIT TIME, never inferred at runtime (Flutter --track-widget-creation pattern). Presence is enforced by Q11 verdict 4. kit/showcase_app was back-stamped at the Q11/Q12 ratification: all 20 view files carry the triple, so the golden probe's showcase corroboration no longer exempts showcase — showcase is normative for identity like everything else.
inspectAttrs.source: intake/registry.json ids, carried through the frozen run artifact
inspectAttrs.rule: Studio inspect mode reads the triple ONLY. Zero DOM heuristics; inspect mode survives regeneration by construction.
inspectAttrs.screenIdSource: intake/registry.json entry ids, verbatim. A screenId outside that set is a gate failure. Class-name convention does NOT resolve it: ShowcaseNotesCreateAccountView carries its shell as a prefix and belongs to registry id 'showcase.createaccount' — the exact filename-convention miss app-architecture.md:169 describes, and the reason the triple is stamped rather than inferred.
inspectAttrs.surfaceIdForm: surface.<feature>.<surface> for a routed surface, surface.<feature>.shell for a shell view — the surface's own tree-derived id. The join to the registry is screenId.
inspectAttrs.anatomyNodeVocabulary: skills/arxa-scaffolder/kind-resolution.registry.json#/anatomyNodes — CLOSED set, ratified at registry v1.2.0. An id outside it is a gate failure on both sides.

artifactTypes.cardinality: one per feature per DERIVED factor

artifactTypes.rule: Descriptive record of one shell's realised design — tokens, widget inventory, layout law — read out of that shell's own source, never aspirational. Hand-written and hand-maintained: the scaffolder neither emits nor rewrites it, and a delta run leaves it untouched. Typed here so the manifest round-trips the showcase tree it was derived from; before this entry it was the one file in showcase that no Q8 expansion could explain.

artifactTypes.cardinality: one per surface per DERIVED factor
one per designed widget node resolved through kind-resolution.registry.json
one per cross-feature widget; group declared in the registry, never inferred
artifactTypes.note: mouse_transforms/ is the documented un-prefixed exception (scale_on_hover_widget.dart, translate_on_hover_widget.dart): generic interaction primitives, not app-branded. Expansion allows an un-prefixed name ONLY when the registry marks the group `appNeutral: true`.

artifactTypes.cardinality: optional, at most one per shared widget group
artifactTypes.note: Layout constants LOCAL to one widget group. Design vocabulary (colors, spacing, glyphs, fonts) must NOT live here — Q6 Tier 1 requires importing kit-core common instead. See kitCommonImports below.

artifactTypes.cardinality: one per feature that declares services

artifactTypes.note: showcase_folder_scope.dart sits in this bucket without the _enum suffix. Expansion treats a missing _enum suffix as FAIL; that file is recorded in exemptions[] so showcase still passes, and new emits always carry the suffix.

artifactTypes.cardinality: exactly one per non-empty bucket directory
artifactTypes.rule: The barrel is named after the BUCKET KIND, never after its directory. showcase_notes_widgets/ -> widgets.dart (NOT showcase_notes_widgets.dart).

artifactTypes.cardinality: one per root layer that has one
artifactTypes.instancesVerified: All six instances confirmed present in kit/showcase_app (2026-08-08). Bucket barrels confirmed at 27 total sites; the bucket-kind naming rule holds at every one.
artifactTypes.rule: lib/ui/views has NO barrel — views are imported by full path (verified against showcase). Do not emit one.

artifactTypes.cardinality: zero or more per feature that declares seed data
artifactTypes.note: Q4. NOTE THE LOCATION: app-root data/seed/, NOT lib/. Files are FEATURE-named and are NOT <app>_ prefixed (verified: notes.json, notes_folders.json, kit_auth_users.json) — the one bucket where the <app>_ rule does not apply. The designer's seed mirror must be byte-comparable with these, which is only possible if both sides use the same un-prefixed feature naming.
artifactTypes.gating: Design-time overlay ONLY. Seeds are gated: they load in design/dev boot and must never reach a shipped build. The gate is the point of Q4 — un-gated seed data shipping as real user content is the failure being prevented.

artifactTypes.cardinality: one set per backend the registry declares
artifactTypes.note: Q4. Derived FROM data/seed/ + the schemas, never hand-edited. Emitted by the backend emitter rather than the scaffolder proper; recorded here so the manifest expansion accounts for the files and --check does not flag them as unknown.

Q4. The data-layer boot: registers entities + fixtures with arxa_kit_data, called once from main() after setupLocator(). Regenerated additively as features declare entities. Service registration does NOT live here — it lives in the @StackedApp dependencies in lib/app/app.dart.

artifactTypes.rule: Q9: regenerated deterministically every run; unchanged feature set => byte-identical entries; additive-only diff. app.router.dart is the compiled route table (see routeTable below).
artifactTypes.verificationNote: Verified present in kit/showcase_app (app.dart, app_data.dart confirmed on disk).

artifactTypes.rule: The manifest gates/coverage reads: selfContained shells + the {shell: {surfaceId: dir}} map + per-surface `kits`. Directory name is a scaffolder DECISION (coverage refuses to guess it), recorded so the gate can check it.
artifactTypes.verificationNote: NO showcase instance by design: this is a NEW scaffolder-emitted artifact, not a showcase convention. Golden-probe corroboration against showcase must exempt it (same exemption class as inspectAttrs).

artifactTypes.rule: Q9 obligation: the `.copier-answers` analog. Persisted from the FIRST scaffold. Records the registry version id, the run artifact id, the target set, and a content hash per emitted file. The divergence gate verifies user-owned files against this baseline instead of clobbering them; the 3-way merge uses it as the common ancestor.
artifactTypes.verificationNote: NO showcase instance by design: pipeline-state file living outside the app tree (pipeline/state/), not part of the emitted app. Excluded from golden-tree comparison.

exemptions.reason: Pre-manifest file missing the _enum suffix. Grandfathered so showcase passes golden expansion; new emits must carry the suffix.
Hand-written un-prefixed extension with no artifact type. Out of scaffolder scope — the manifest neither emits nor asserts lib/extensions/.
Registration glue, not a recipe artifact. Emitted only when the registry declares snackbars; no path template until that intake shape is locked.

kitCommonImports._comment: Q6 Tier 1. Scaffolded output IMPORTS the kit design vocabulary; it never generates local duplicates. showcase's lib/ui/common was deleted for exactly this reason. Emitting a local colors/spacing/glyphs/fonts file is a FAIL, not a style preference.
kitCommonImports.widgetLibraryNote: The kit-native widget library — 149 imports across showcase, the single most imported package. Every widget the kind-resolution registry resolves to comes from here.

routeTable._comment: Unchanged by the grill and still binding. ONE go_router-shaped table compiled from intake/registry.json + intake/flows.json (exact shapes per arxa/lib/intake.dart), emitted as lib/app/app.router.dart.
rules: Typed nav ops only — push, replace, back. `modal` is a presentation flag on the destination, never a fourth verb.
`system` edges are non-gesture (auth-success, deep-link): they compile to route guards, never to buttons.
Guards are named predicates — requiresAuth:true entries plus system edges compile to ONE redirect, not per-route copies.
Tabs are data — tab:true entries form the bottom-tab shell, in registry order.
Flow row order is edge-chain order — the table adds no reordering.
A flow needing something the registry does not declare is a DESIGN DEFECT, not a scaffolder branch.

l10n._comment: Unchanged by the grill. Backward-compatible: a design with no l10n/ dir gets NO l10n artifacts.
l10n.rootFileContract: gen-l10n; template-arb-file: app_en.arb; no synthetic package
l10n.checkedBy: --check asserts the catalog file set + l10n.yaml
l10n.pubspecNote: flutter_localizations, intl and flutter.generate:true are emitted unconditionally by arxa/lib/blueprint.dart — NOT by the scaffolder.

goldenExpansionProbe._comment: Q8 gate + Q11 verdict 1. The full locked verdict list lives in verdicts[] below so the probe reads it from the SSOT rather than from prose.
goldenExpansionProbe.rule: Expand this manifest for the synthetic feature, diff the produced tree against the expansion. Extra file or missing file = FAIL.
goldenExpansionProbe.showcaseCorroboration: Showcase itself MUST pass expansion (modulo exemptions[]). If it does not, the manifest is wrong — not the showcase.

q11Surfaces.note: auth/design/splashscreen are absent from showcase and expand from the manifest exactly like `payments`. splashscreen is NOT a shell — it is the mobile-device splash surface, brand logo only.

verdicts.rule: Emitted tree matches this manifest's expansion exactly. Extra or missing file = fail.
A second run on unchanged inputs is byte-identical.
verdicts.caveat: Per the Q2<->Q11 audit resolution: transformation output is LLM-touched and is pinned by its frozen run artifact (Q10) plus the non-clobber rule, NOT by byte-identity. Asserting byte-identity over transformation output is a misreading of this verdict and has been made once already.

verdicts.rule: Every emitted surface carries inspectAttrs (see inspectAttrs.requiredOn).
Q5 frontmatter/comment conventions present, mechanically enforced (see frontmatterKinds).

goldenExpansionProbe.harness: One probe, five verdicts, reusing existing ProbeReport / ProbeTarget plumbing. No new harness.
goldenExpansionProbe._expansionNote: Showcase instances corroborate the seven real shells only; absentSurfaceExamples are manifest-derived.
goldenExpansionProbe.nonVerdictInvariant: Kit-only vocabulary (no local design-vocabulary duplicates; every widget resolves via kind-resolution.registry.json) is an always-on emit-time invariant, deliberately NOT one of the five verdicts.
goldenExpansionProbe._shellsNote: Verified against kit/showcase_app/lib/ui/views/ — dir name is showcase_<shell>_shell. This is the corroboration set: real dirs the probe can diff against.
goldenExpansionProbe._absentNote: NOT shells and NOT in showcase. They expand from this manifest alone, exactly like the synthetic `payments` feature — the manifest is the authority where showcase offers no instance. `splashscreen` additionally is not a shell at all (mobile-device splash surface, brand logo only).

dependencyOverrides._comment: F1. pub honours dependency_overrides from the ROOT package only, so a path dependency's own overrides do not propagate to a scaffolded app. arxa_kit_data declares these; every emitted app must replicate them verbatim or its first Windows build breaks. Recorded here so the emitted pubspec's override block is explained by the contract rather than only by kit/data prose (kit/data/README.md:41, kit/data/AGENTS.md:65) — prose the scaffolder cannot mechanically check itself against.
dependencyOverrides.rule: Emit verbatim into every scaffolded app pubspec.yaml. Not optional, not version-floated.
dependencyOverrides.cause: appwrite's transitive graph pins win32 5.x while arxa_kit_core -> talker_flutter -> share_plus 13 requires win32 ^6. win32 is Windows-only FFI, so forcing 6.x is safe on every other platform.
